type: Lockstitch / interlock sewing machine S68 electronic control box

specs.display: Multi-digit 7-segment LED with motor rotation direction icon (two squares), numerical display for stitch count, speed, and special functions
specs.panelColor: Yellow panel with P, S, A, B, C, D buttons and dedicated function LEDs
specs.interface: P (parameter/save), S (save parameter in setting mode), A/B/C/D (function and value buttons), plus dedicated keys for needle up/down, soft start, presser foot, trimming, soft start
specs.parameterLevelA: Normal mode: press P briefly — enters first parameter code 001
specs.parameterLevelB: Technician: hold P and turn on power — enters at code 047
specs.parameterLevelC: Factory: hold S and turn on power — enters at code 123
specs.monitorMode: Standby mode: press P + S (number key) combination — shows code 06 (mechanical angle) first
specs.autoTest: Press P + S combo to enter auto-test interface; select T-r-20/T-S-10/T-W-00 parameters
specs.saveUserParams: Method 1: enter param level C, find 123.FAS, short press A key. Method 2: enter monitor angle mode, long press C key until shows '------' then release
specs.restoreUserParams: Method 1: hold A+B keys and turn on power. Method 2: enter monitor angle mode, long press A key until shows '------' then release
specs.restoreFactoryParams: Machine head factory only: enter level B params, set parameter 047 to target model code, press S to confirm
specs.machineCode: Parameter MAC (code 047) sets machine type — default 630 for 8770 machine

note: S68 controller has 3 parameter levels (A/B/C) with hundreds of parameters. Error codes use ER0.X format (e.g. ER0.1, ER0.7, ER0.107). The MAC (machine code) parameter [047] determines the machine head type — default value 630 corresponds to the 8770. Special 4-pin 6-wire machine interface uses P1-P6 sub-parameters. Up-needle position adjustment is critical — do not open motor rear cover without permission.

errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power, restart after 15 seconds. If the controller still does not work, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.
Turn off the system power, restart after 15 seconds. If still does not work, please replace it and inform the manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Over voltage during standby mode — supply voltage higher than 264V
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect the controller power and check if the input voltage is too high (higher than 264V). If yes, restart the controller when the normal voltage is resumed. If the controller still does not work when voltage is at normal level, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: System under voltage — supply voltage lower than 176V
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect the controller power and check if the input voltage is too low (lower than 176V). If yes, restart the controller when the normal voltage is resumed. If the controller still does not work when voltage is at normal level, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Motor stalled — motor stuck, foreign objects in pulley, material too heavy
errorCodes.solution: Motor and machine will be shutting down. Please check the motor or motor connectors' connection. Please check machine head to see if objects are stuck in the motor pulley, or if it does not rotate smoothly.

errorCodes.cause: Communication error — operation panel disconnected or cable loose
errorCodes.solution: Motor and machine will be shutting down. Please check the Operation panel and the cable of the operation panel.

errorCodes.cause: Solenoid circuit failure — solenoid not connected correctly, loose or damaged
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power. Check whether the solenoid is connected correctly, loose or damaged. If there is any defect, please replace it immediately. Restart the system and check whether the function is good or not. If it still does not work, inform the technical support.
Turn off the system power, restart after 15 seconds and check whether it works well. If not, try several more times. If the same failure happens frequently, inform the technical service.

errorCodes.cause: Brake circuit failure — white resistance cable loose or disconnected on main board
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power. Check whether the cable of the white resistance is loose or disconnecting to the jack on the main board. Please reconnect it and restart the system. If it still does not work, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Motor hall failure — motor sensor plug loose or disconnecting
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power. Check whether the motor sensor plug is loose or disconnecting. Please reconnect it and restart the system. If it still does not work, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.
Turn off the system power, restart the system after 15 seconds. If it still does not work, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.
Turn off the system power, restart the system after 15 seconds. If it still does not work, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.
Turn off the system power, restart the system after 15 seconds. If it still does not work, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Cutting protection switch — safety switch faulty or bad connection. Motor rotation icon in LCD halting and not moving.
errorCodes.solution: Restart the system and check whether the fault is removed. Please check parameter [075.SFM] setting — make sure it matches machine head safety switch type (NO=normal open, NC=normal close). Note: parameter [145.SFM] setting enables or disables this function.

errorCodes.cause: Pedal failure — pedal not properly connected
errorCodes.solution: Please check that the pedal is properly connected.

parameters.note: S68 has three parameter levels. Level A = normal user access (press P in standby). Level B = technician (hold P, power on — starts at code 047). Level C = factory (hold S, power on — starts at code 123). Parameters are referenced by code number [001], [002], etc. or by code name [H], [SLM], etc.

troubleshooting.symptom: ER0.119 cutting protection switch on 8770 / S68
checks: Motor rotation icon on LCD is halting (not moving) — this is the key symptom
Restart the system and check if the fault is removed
Check parameter [075.SFM] — this must match the actual safety switch type on the machine head
If machine head uses normally-open (NO) switch: set SFM=NO
If machine head uses normally-close (NC) switch: set SFM=NC
Parameter [145.IN2] setting enables or disables this function (2=enable, 0=close)
Inspect the safety switch cable connection — check for loose or broken wires
Motor and machine will shut down automatically
Check motor connector and cable connections are secure
Check machine head for foreign objects stuck in motor pulley
Rotate hand wheel manually to check if mechanism moves freely
Reduce material thickness or check that fabric is not too heavy for the machine settings
Check L (low speed) and M (middle speed) parameter values are not set too high
Motor and machine will shut down automatically
Check the operation panel cable is firmly connected to both the panel and controller
Try reconnecting the panel cable
If error persists after reconnecting, the operation panel or controller may need replacement

troubleshooting.symptom: Up-needle position incorrect on startup for 8770
checks: Do NOT open the motor rear cover to adjust the needle position magnet without guidance
Method 1 (motor with needle position sensor+magnet): Adjust needle bar to target up position, then adjust needle position magnet to sensor position

Method 2 (motor without needle position sensor): Press pedal, verify motor runs correctly. Enter monitor mode [06] (mechanical angle). Turn hand wheel to target up position. Press and hold D key — machine saves up position automatically
Both methods are described in manual section 5.2 and 5.3
THIS OPERATION IS FOR MACHINE HEAD FACTORY ONLY
Step 1: Access parameter level B (hold P key, turn on power — shows 047)
Step 2: Set parameter 047 (MAC - Machine Code) to the target model code (default 630 for 8770)
Step 3: Press S key to start the recovery process
Warning: This will overwrite all custom parameter settings
When operating in 4-pin 6-wire interlock mode, the display shows a special interface (3.P1.0)
Press A key to select parameter number (P1-P6)
Press B, C, D keys to adjust parameter values
P1: Reserved
P2: Number of stitches in front suction (0=closed)
P3: Reserved
P4: Reserved
P5: Number of stitches in front cut delay (0=closed) — larger value = shorter front end thread
P6: After cutting thread delay stitches (0=closed) — larger value = longer back end thread
